No two-dimensional flow satisfies the hypotheses of Proposition 3.2.
Proof

↗ cor:point-picking-time-independent \sketch The proposition would produce a product of two one-dimensional manifolds, hence a flat limit, contradicting the normalization $R(q_\infty ,-1)=1$.
